problem:
Which of the following matrices are block diagonal?

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 1 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}3 & 0 \\ 2 & 0\end{aligned}],\,C=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 0 \\ 1 & 5 & 0 \\ 4 & 5 & 3\end{aligned}].
$$

feedback.problem: Find $\,|\begin{aligned}4 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 3 & m & b & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & n & 0 \\ 8 & 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}|$ given that $\,|\begin{aligned}m & b \\ 0 & n\end{aligned}|=-6.$
feedback.worked_solution:
Notice that we have a block lower triangular matrix. Therefore, its determinant is equal to the product of the diagonal blocks' determinants:

$$
\begin{aligned}|\begin{aligned}4 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 3 & m & b & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & n & 0 \\ 8 & 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}| & =|\begin{aligned}4 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 3 & m & b & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & n & 0 \\ 8 & 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}| \\  & =4\cdot |\begin{aligned}m & b \\ 0 & n\end{aligned}|\cdot 3 \\  & =4\cdot (-6)\cdot 3 \\  & =-72.\end{aligned}
$$
